```{r,echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,error=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())

library(pROC)
library(HandTill2001)
source(file.path("R","multi_brier.R"))
source(file.path("R","multi_logloss.R"))

load(file.path("results","nt1000.2b.CVresults.RData"))

options(max.print = 1000000)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Class names
# IMPORTANT: define this BEFORE factor(..., levels=classes)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
if (is.null(colnames(scores))) {
  stop("scores has no column names; class names cannot be determined.")
}
classes <- colnames(scores)

if (!is.null(colnames(probs)) && !identical(colnames(probs), classes)) {
  stop("Column names/order of scores and probs are different.")
}

cat("Number of classes:", length(classes), "\n")
cat("scores:", paste(dim(scores), collapse=" x "), "\n")
cat("probs :", paste(dim(probs), collapse=" x "), "\n\n")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Overall multiclass performance only
# (NO per-class / 65 individual AUCs)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
AUCscores <- HandTill2001::auc(
  multcap(response=as.factor(y), predicted=scores)
)
AUCprobs <- HandTill2001::auc(
  multcap(response=as.factor(y), predicted=probs)
)

errs <- sum(y != ys) / length(y)
errp <- sum(y != yp) / length(y)

briers <- brier(scores, y)
brierp <- brier(probs, y)

logls <- mlogloss(scores, y)
loglp <- mlogloss(probs, y)

out <- cbind(
  c(AUCscores, AUCprobs),
  c(errs, errp),
  c(briers, brierp),
  c(logls, loglp)
)
colnames(out) <- c("auc", "misclassification", "brier score", "logloss")
rownames(out) <- c("raw scores", "calibrated scores")
print(out)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 65 x 65 confusion matrices
# Keep all class levels even when a class is never predicted.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
y.true       <- factor(as.character(y),  levels=classes)
y.score      <- factor(as.character(ys), levels=classes)
y.calibrated <- factor(as.character(yp), levels=classes)

cm_score <- table(y.true, y.score)
cm_calibrated <- table(y.true, y.calibrated)

cat("\nRaw-score confusion matrix dimension:",
    paste(dim(cm_score), collapse=" x "), "\n")
print(cm_score)

cat("\nCalibrated-score confusion matrix dimension:",
    paste(dim(cm_calibrated), collapse=" x "), "\n")
print(cm_calibrated)

write.csv(as.matrix(cm_score),
          file.path("results", "nt1000.2b.confusion_raw.csv"),
          row.names=TRUE)
write.csv(as.matrix(cm_calibrated),
          file.path("results", "nt1000.2b.confusion_calibrated.csv"),
          row.names=TRUE)
```

## Calibrated-score confusion matrix

```{r,echo=FALSE,message=FALSE,error=FALSE,warning=FALSE,fig.height=9,fig.width=9}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Fig.2-like 65 x 65 confusion matrix
# - rows: annotated / true class
# - columns: predicted class
# - each row normalized to 100%
# - class colour strips from Supplementary Excel
# - black boxes for methylation class families (MCF)
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if (!requireNamespace("readxl", quietly=TRUE)) {
  stop('Package "readxl" is required. Run install.packages("readxl") once.')
}

xlsx_name <- "41467_2020_20603_MOESM5_ESM.xlsx"
xlsx_candidates <- c(
  xlsx_name,
  file.path("results", xlsx_name),
  file.path("data", xlsx_name)
)
xlsx_path <- xlsx_candidates[file.exists(xlsx_candidates)][1]

if (is.na(xlsx_path)) {
  stop(paste0(
    "Cannot find ", xlsx_name,
    ". Put it in the project root, results/, or data/."
  ))
}

meta0 <- readxl::read_excel(xlsx_path, skip=1)

# The supplementary Excel has 65 rows.
meta <- data.frame(
  full   = trimws(as.character(meta0[[1]])),
  abbr   = trimws(as.character(meta0[[2]])),
  family = trimws(as.character(meta0[[4]])),
  colour = trimws(as.character(meta0[[14]])),
  stringsAsFactors=FALSE
)
meta <- meta[!is.na(meta$full) & meta$full != "", ]

# Match model class names to the supplementary Excel.
# First try exact matching. This avoids locale/encoding problems.
idx <- match(classes, meta$full)

# Fallback only for names that differ by punctuation/spacing.
# Keep this ASCII-only so it works even on R sessions with a non-UTF-8 locale.
ascii_key <- function(x) {
  x0 <- as.character(x)
  x1 <- suppressWarnings(iconv(x0, from="", to="ASCII//TRANSLIT", sub=""))
  x1[is.na(x1)] <- ""
  x1 <- tolower(x1)
  gsub("[^a-z0-9]+", "", x1)
}

if (anyNA(idx)) {
  miss <- which(is.na(idx))
  idx[miss] <- match(ascii_key(classes[miss]), ascii_key(meta$full))
}

if (anyNA(idx)) {
  warning(
    paste0(
      "The following model classes were not found in the colour-code Excel: ",
      paste(classes[is.na(idx)], collapse=" | "),
      ". Grey will be used for those classes."
    )
  )
}

abbr <- meta$abbr[idx]
colour <- meta$colour[idx]
family <- meta$family[idx]

# Fallbacks for unmatched / blank cells.
abbr[is.na(abbr) | abbr == ""] <- classes[is.na(abbr) | abbr == ""]
colour[is.na(colour) | colour == "" | colour == "NA"] <- "#BDBDBD"
family[is.na(family) | family == ""] <- "not applicable"

# The supplied Excel has a blank Figure Colour Code for RMS (MYOD1),
# therefore grey is used only for that blank/missing entry.

# Make the two MCF blocks contiguous, as in Fig. 2.
super_family <- rep(NA_character_, length(classes))
super_family[family %in% c("MCF CSA", "MCF CSA (IDH)")] <- "MCF CSA / CSA (IDH)"
super_family[family == "MCF SARC (BCOR)"] <- "MCF SARC (BCOR)"

# Preserve the original model class order, except that members of each
# MCF are gathered together at the position of the first member.
make_grouped_order <- function(n, group) {
  out <- integer(0)
  used <- rep(FALSE, n)
  groups <- unique(group[!is.na(group)])

  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    if (used[i]) next

    if (!is.na(group[i])) {
      gidx <- which(group == group[i])
      out <- c(out, gidx)
      used[gidx] <- TRUE
    } else {
      out <- c(out, i)
      used[i] <- TRUE
    }
  }
  out
}

ord <- make_grouped_order(length(classes), super_family)
plot_classes <- classes[ord]
plot_abbr <- abbr[ord]
plot_colour <- colour[ord]
plot_family <- super_family[ord]

# Reverse only the Predicted axis (x-axis), as requested.
x_classes <- rev(plot_classes)
x_abbr <- rev(plot_abbr)
x_colour <- rev(plot_colour)

# Reorder matrix and convert each annotated class (row) to percentage.
cm_plot <- as.matrix(cm_calibrated)[plot_classes, x_classes, drop=FALSE]
row_total <- rowSums(cm_plot)
cm_pct <- sweep(cm_plot, 1, ifelse(row_total == 0, 1, row_total), "/") * 100

# Save the percentage matrix and class key.
write.csv(round(cm_pct, 3),
          file.path("results", "nt1000.2b.confusion_calibrated_percent.csv"),
          row.names=TRUE)

class_key_out <- data.frame(
  annotated_order=seq_along(plot_classes),
  annotated_class=plot_classes,
  annotated_abbreviation=plot_abbr,
  annotated_colour=plot_colour,
  predicted_order=seq_along(x_classes),
  predicted_class=x_classes,
  predicted_abbreviation=x_abbr,
  predicted_colour=x_colour,
  MCF=ifelse(is.na(plot_family), "", plot_family),
  stringsAsFactors=FALSE
)
write.csv(class_key_out,
          file.path("results", "nt1000.2b.confusion_class_key.csv"),
          row.names=FALSE)

# Colour scale similar to Fig. 2.
heat_cols <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(
  c("#FFFFFF", "#DEEBF7", "#9ECAE1", "#4292C6", "#08519C")
)(101)

# Main plotting function.
draw_cm_fig2 <- function(show_abbreviations=FALSE) {
  n <- nrow(cm_pct)

  # Wider right margin / x-range to give the legend its own space.
  par(mar=c(5.2, 5.2, 1.6, 11.5), xaxs="i", yaxs="i")
  plot.new()
  plot.window(xlim=c(0.5, n+14.0), ylim=c(0.5, n+0.5), asp=1)

  # heatmap cells: first true class is placed at the top
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    yy <- n - i + 1
    for (j in seq_len(n)) {
      v <- cm_pct[i, j]
      ci <- max(1, min(101, round(v) + 1))
      rect(j-0.5, yy-0.5, j+0.5, yy+0.5,
           col=heat_cols[ci], border=NA)
    }
  }

  # very light cell grid
  abline(v=seq(0.5, n+0.5, by=1), h=seq(0.5, n+0.5, by=1),
         col="#F1F1F1", lwd=0.18)

  # Explicit outer border around the heatmap body.
  rect(0.5, 0.5, n+0.5, n+0.5, border="#555555", lwd=0.8)

  # MCF black squares removed at user request.

  # Colour strips for every class, matching Supplementary Data colour code.
  par(xpd=NA)
  for (j in seq_len(n)) {
    rect(j-0.5, -0.35, j+0.5, 0.15,
         col=x_colour[j], border=NA)
  }
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    yy <- n - i + 1
    rect(-0.35, yy-0.5, 0.15, yy+0.5,
         col=plot_colour[i], border=NA)
  }

  # Optional abbreviations. Fig.2 itself essentially relies on colour strips,
  # so FALSE gives the closest appearance and avoids unreadable 65 labels.
  if (show_abbreviations) {
    cex_lab <- 0.30
    text(seq_len(n), -0.85, labels=x_abbr,
         srt=90, adj=1, cex=cex_lab)
    text(-0.85, n-seq_len(n)+1, labels=plot_abbr,
         adj=1, cex=cex_lab)
  }

  text((n + 1) / 2, -1.10, labels="Predicted", cex=0.85)
  text(-1.10, (n + 1) / 2, labels="Annotated", srt=90, cex=0.85)

  # vertical 0--100% colour key on the right
  key_x1 <- n + 7.0
  key_x2 <- n + 8.6
  key_y1 <- 9
  key_y2 <- 33
  dy <- (key_y2-key_y1)/101
  for (k in 0:100) {
    rect(key_x1, key_y1+k*dy, key_x2, key_y1+(k+1)*dy,
         col=heat_cols[k+1], border=NA)
  }
  rect(key_x1, key_y1, key_x2, key_y2, border="grey40", lwd=0.5)
  for (v in c(0,25,50,75,100)) {
    yy <- key_y1 + (key_y2-key_y1)*v/100
    segments(key_x2, yy, key_x2+0.28, yy, col="grey30")
    text(key_x2+0.55, yy, labels=v, adj=0, cex=0.58)
  }
  text((key_x1+key_x2)/2, key_y2+2.2,
       labels="Samples in annotated\nclasses (%)",
       cex=0.58, adj=c(0.5,0))
}

# Draw in the HTML.
draw_cm_fig2(show_abbreviations=FALSE)

# Also save high-resolution standalone files.
png(file.path("results", "nt1000.2b.confusion_calibrated_Fig2style.png"),
    width=2700, height=2700, res=300, bg="white")
draw_cm_fig2(show_abbreviations=FALSE)
dev.off()

pdf(file.path("results", "nt1000.2b.confusion_calibrated_Fig2style.pdf"),
    width=9, height=9, useDingbats=FALSE)
draw_cm_fig2(show_abbreviations=FALSE)
dev.off()
```
